content.short: CG Meta Game hosts monthly quests in various Web3 games, offering play-to-earn experiences.
content.description: CG Meta Game runs Web3 game quests that feature play-to-earn experiences and rewards. Each month, a new quest is hosted in a different Web3 game, generating play-to-earn opportunities for its community and delivering a powerful user acquisition channel for game developers. By connecting players with creators, CG Meta Game aims to elevate the gaming experience and promote collaborative, blockchain-based entertainment. This approach helps players discover Web3 games and sustains developers with ongoing visibility in an evolving ecosystem.
